title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - Resource
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/Resource. Description of a good or object of the Gaia-X Ecosystem, and may be aggregated in a Service Offering or exist independently of it. Subclass of GaiaXEntity per the Gaia-X ontology; inherited properties are documented on the GaiaXEntity model and not repeated here. The source ontology marks this class as abstract, not intended for direct instantiation.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Resource'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

aggregationOfResources.description: Relationship. Resources related to the resource and that can exist independently of it. Links to one or more Resource entities.
